app.name: anySCP
app.one_liner: A modern desktop client for SSH, SFTP, and S3 with a clean, powerful interface.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Display host and cloud storage cards with quick actions to launch terminals or file explorers.

screens.name: File Explorer
screens.purpose: Browse and transfer files via SFTP or SCP (with automatic fallback) or S3-compatible storage.

screens.name: Settings
screens.purpose: Configure appearance, connections, and application behavior including theme selection.

screens.name: SSH Terminal
screens.purpose: Provide interactive shell access to remote hosts with support for split panes and command snippets.

rust_commands.name: browse_files
rust_commands.purpose: List remote files using SFTP or fallback SCP transport depending on server capabilities.

rust_commands.name: connect_ssh
rust_commands.purpose: Establish SSH connection to a remote host for terminal or file operations.

rust_commands.name: save_connection
rust_commands.purpose: Persist connection details securely using OS keychain without cloud sync.

rust_commands.name: transfer_file
rust_commands.purpose: Upload or download files using SFTP or SCP with portable command handling across GNU, BSD, and busybox environments.

mvp_plan: week 1: Build SFTP browser with drag-and-drop support
week 1: Implement core SSH terminal with split panes
week 2: Add SCP fallback logic for servers without SFTP
week 2: Integrate OS keychain for secure credential storage
week 3: Add command snippet management UI
week 3: Implement S3-compatible cloud storage browser
week 4: Develop unified dashboard with host/cloud cards
week 4: Implement light/dark theme switching in settings
acceptance_tests: Credentials are never sent to any external service and remain stored only in OS keychain.
File transfers work consistently across GNU Linux, Alpine (busybox), and macOS/BSD remote servers.
On macOS, user can connect via SSH and open an SFTP file browser that lists remote files correctly.
User can switch to light theme in Settings and it persists after restart without flash of dark theme.
When SFTP subsystem is disabled on server, file browser automatically falls back to SCP without user intervention.
